description: Find which big retailers and brand stores to search for a product, with a ready-made search link for each. Use this when search_products returns nothing, when the shopper names a store or brand, or to give the shopper places to look. Returns up to 10 retailers (the brand's own store first, then category specialists, then general retailers), each with search_url, a short reason, and agent_access ('open' = you can fetch the page, 'blocks_bots' = hand the link to the shopper). No key needed. Example: {"query": "breville espresso machine", "region": "AU"}.

query.description: The product, e.g. 'wide fit hiking boots'. Leave out budget and size; they are stripped.

region.description: Shopper's country. Only retailers that serve it are returned. Coverage is deepest for AU.

name: find_retailers
title: Find retailer search links
